calibration.claim: Shared nominal validation target, not exact equal test FPR or population error guarantee

primary_test.any3_positive: All three marked payload covers scored by matching method, source-average and payload-specific results
primary_test.negative: Unmarked photographs; unmarked AI false watermark matches reported separately
